messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but they support prioritizing these signal-integrity-related capabilities for wireless/network-infrastructure applications: high-speed digital and power verification/debugging, channel/interface validation, PCB/PCBA SI flow metrics, timing/jitter analysis, PDN analysis, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and—where beamforming/O-RAN is in scope—multiport amplitude/phase/time relation measurements [4][69][1][2][25].
- High-speed digital and power verification/debugging: mobile network infrastructure drivers include “Digital Design & Power,” and high-speed digital and power designs are described as needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools such as VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [4][69].
- Transmission-channel and interface validation: the supported SI/PI test context includes Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, channel/test board/switch matrices, and interface test using scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][2].
- PCB/PCBA SI flow measurements: the high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow explicitly lists insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and transmission-line calculator [1][2].
- PCB material, stackup, and modeling/testing capabilities: R&S PCB test solutions list impedance by TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, and process monitoring [13][64].
- Timing and jitter capability: RefClk and PLL jitter performance is a validation block mapped to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][2].
- Power integrity / PDN capability: Power Distribution Network testing is a validation block mapped to oscilloscopes and network analyzers [1][2].
- ADC/DAC frontend validation: ADC/DAC frontend performance is a validation block mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][2].
- Beamforming/O-RAN multiport integrity capability: O-RAN beamforming measurements require measuring amplitude and phase/time relation between antenna ports and calculating beam direction or beam weights, with at least two antenna ports measured [25][82].

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

O-RU testing › 不可推論的內容
目前不能由這些來源推論：

- [[O-RAN Alliance WG4 Conformance Specifications]] 的完整正式版本、profile、test case IDs、certification authority 或 plugfest / certification status。
- `ORAN-WG4.CONF-v06.00` 是否為最新或正式採用版本。
- [[O-RAN 3GPP Conformance Testing Feasibility]] technical report 的最終發布狀態；[[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]] 只說 currently under review。
- R&S O-RU tester / VIAVI O-RU Tester 的完整產品型號、license、software version、support matrix 或 order number。
- O-RU conformance、interoperability、performance 或 production test 的完整測試矩陣。
- Isolated O-RU Rx characteristics 的結果可直接等同 pair-wise O-DU / O-RU testing；來源明確說結果會不同。
- Rx performance 不能由 isolated O-RU testing 替代；來源說 only pairwise testing is possible。
- [[ETSI ES 202 706-1]] 的版本、適用 radio unit 類型、measurement methods、limits 或 pass / fail criteria。
- Optional anechoic chamber 的完整型號與配置；本來源只補出 [[R&S PWC200]] 與 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 線索。

O-RU testing › R&S portfolio for O-RU testing
- Slide 21 說 isolated testing is not described in `O-RAN.WG4.3GPP-Conformance-Testing-TR-v00.12`，且 isolated setup cannot replace pair-wise testing for 3GPP tests。
- Slide 21 說 TX characteristics in isolated testing of an O-RU seems feasible；RX characteristics in isolated O-RU testing has several challenges；RX performance only pairwise testing is possible。
- Slide 26 說 3GPP receiver characteristic testing requires throughput calculation，VSE 已實作 BLER 與 Tput parameters，並把 isolated O-RU receiver testing 定位為 pre-conformance use case。
- Slide 33 說 O-RAN.WG4.CONF 多數測試 single antenna port at a time；one port analyzer and generator configuration is sufficient。MIMO testing typically done for receiver performance；MIMO transmitter tests are not defined by 3GPP for infrastructure；beamforming tests require magnitude and phase relations between antenna ports。
- Slide 35–38 說 VSE-K175 支援 O-RAN measurements，SMW-K175 支援 U-Plane generation，O-RAN PCAP Converter 可把 captured Ethernet stream 轉為 VSE file format，供 VSE 分析 UL / DL U-Plane data。
- Slide 40–44 建立 [[O-RAN Beamforming Measurements]] 線索：至少 2 connectors to DUT、sequential measurement allowed、TER 需 extract / calculate weights、mag/phase relation or beam direction；DL / UL setup 使用 [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S OSP]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 PCAP capture。
- Slide 46–48 給出 O-RAN 5G FR1、O-RAN 5G FR1 incl. BF tests、O-RAN 5G FR1 + 3GPP Conformance Ch. 6/7 與 Upgrade to FR2 的 typical / detailed configuration。
- Slide 50–52 補充 [[R&S PWC200]] 與 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 作為 OTA / chamber 方案。

answer.text:
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list, but they support prioritizing these signal-integrity-related capabilities for wireless/network-infrastructure applications: high-speed digital and power verification/debugging, channel/interface validation, PCB/PCBA SI flow metrics, timing/jitter analysis, PDN analysis, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and—where beamforming/O-RAN is in scope—multiport amplitude/phase/time relation measurements [4][69][1][2][25].
- High-speed digital and power verification/debugging: mobile network infrastructure drivers include “Digital Design & Power,” and high-speed digital and power designs are described as needing fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools such as VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [4][69].
- Transmission-channel and interface validation: the supported SI/PI test context includes Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, channel/test board/switch matrices, and interface test using scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][2].
- PCB/PCBA SI flow measurements: the high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow explicitly lists insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planner, and transmission-line calculator [1][2].
- PCB material, stackup, and modeling/testing capabilities: R&S PCB test solutions list impedance by TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, sampling testing, and process monitoring [13][64].
- Timing and jitter capability: RefClk and PLL jitter performance is a validation block mapped to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][2].
- Power integrity / PDN capability: Power Distribution Network testing is a validation block mapped to oscilloscopes and network analyzers [1][2].
- ADC/DAC frontend validation: ADC/DAC frontend performance is a validation block mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][2].
- Beamforming/O-RAN multiport integrity capability: O-RAN beamforming measurements require measuring amplitude and phase/time relation between antenna ports and calculating beam direction or beam weights, with at least two antenna ports measured [25][82].

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

[[O-RAN Beamforming Measurements]] 是 [[O-RAN WG4 Conformance Testing]] 中針對 O-RU antenna ports 的 amplitude、phase / time relation、beam weights 與 beam direction 的 conducted beamforming 測量主題；目前由 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023）支撐。
